canonicalIdentity.strategicPurpose: Produce causal feature records from observation data without Outcome or future provenance dependency.

ownerDecisions.subject: FeatureWindowSpec ladder
ownerDecisions.decision: The admissible FeatureWindowSpec ladder is exactly [5,21,63,126,252]. It is admissible, not cartesian, and counts canonical DAILY trading-session units. TradingSessionUnit(T) is distinct from KnowledgeCutoffBoundary(K).

ownerDecisions.subject: price basis
ownerDecisions.decision: Price basis is SPLIT_ADJUSTED. Arbitrary valid ratios, including 2:1, 11:10, 3:2 and reverse 1:10, are supported without integer or >=1 assumptions. The rule is strict point-in-time: later corporate-action restatement does not rewrite historical FeatureRecords. SPLIT_ADJUSTED is not TOTAL_RETURN_ADJUSTED and no implicit dividend total return is allowed.

ownerDecisions.subject: cross-sectional scope
ownerDecisions.decision: CROSS_SECTIONAL is DEFER. There is no cross-sectional implementation in V1.

ownerDecisions.subject: core feature resolution
ownerDecisions.decision: CORE_FEATURE_SET is exactly (F1 simple-return, W5) and (F1 simple-return, W21). vectorStatus RESOLVED means the core is resolved, not that every non-core member is usable. A declared non-core member may be INSUFFICIENT_DATA or FAIL_CLOSED while vectorStatus remains RESOLVED if the core is resolved. A missing declared member remains fail-closed.

ownerDecisions.subject: KnowledgeCutoff V1
ownerDecisions.decision: K(T) equals PinnedCanonicalSession(T).closeUtc, where PinnedCanonicalSession(T) is the unique canonical session record under the pinned calendar/session policy with sessionDate equal to T and sessionKind in allowedSessionKinds. HALF_DAY_SESSION and REGULAR_SESSION each use their own canonical closeUtc. marketSession.mjs::sessionCloseUtc and wall-clock constants are forbidden. INITIAL_ROOT settlingAt(T) is NOT_EXECUTABLE_WITH_CURRENT_PRIMITIVES and is a FUTURE_ADDITIVE_OPTION.

immutableInvariants.rule: FeatureWindowSpec counts canonical DAILY trading-session units and is distinct from KnowledgeCutoffBoundary.
vectorStatus RESOLVED means exactly that the core feature set is resolved; it does not assert usability of every non-core member.
Declared non-core members remain individually inspectable and may be INSUFFICIENT_DATA or FAIL_CLOSED; omission of a declared member is fail-closed.
KnowledgeCutoff uses the canonical closeUtc of the unique pinned canonical session and no wall-clock constant.
KnowledgeCutoff is disclosed as PinnedCanonicalSession(T).closeUtc under the pinned calendar/session policy.
Consumers decide against the disclosed canonical-session cutoff; INITIAL_ROOT settlingAt(T) remains a future additive, non-executable option.
The calendar/session policy binding is not reduced to a single-valued wall-clock convention.
Window units are canonical DAILY trading-session units; they are not a count of distinct calendar days.
FeatureRecordId is sha256Canonical of exactly the ordered 11-member tuple declared in featureRecordIdentity; closureRule is EXACT_ONLY.
GATE22 Outcome is forbidden as a GATE23 feature directly, lagged, renamed, or through same-type laundering.
